messages:
oncall-bot: PagerDuty: HIGH-PRIORITY pager for hosted-prod - increased 5xx rate on /v1/chat/generate (region: us-west-2). Alert: error_rate > 5% for 3m. Assigned to @evan as responder.
oncall-bot: Incident channel created: #incidents. Thread root ts: 1759123456
ev an: Ack — looking. grabbing logs and recent deploys.
maya: seeing spikes in latencies and a sharp rise in small 400/500s from the runtime: 'batch dispatch failed - mismatch: tool_call'.
liu: logs show a sudden change in KV cache item counts: prefix kv:kcache:user: grew 50x in last 5m. suspect cache key explosion.
ev an: Correlating with traffic, appears to coincide with a feature toggle rollout for structured tool-calling responses + new structured output util (rollout id: rollout-2026-03-15-phi).
sam: that's the canary we pushed earlier today. we had an experimental structured-output->toolcall flattening patch.
jess: quick impact summary from telemetry: 12% of requests in the last 10m fell back with 5xx or timeout, overall p99 latency spiked to 4.1s (baseline ~300ms). Some customers reporting degraded chat responses.
incident_commander: assigning incident commander to @jess. primary goal: mitigate customer impact, contain load, restore normal batching behavior.
jess: plan: 1) stop the structured-output rollout 2) clamp batching config to fail-safe values 3) evict/trim affected KV namespace 4) monitor. Starting action 1 now.
ev an: flipping feature flag: structured-output-toolcall -> off for hosted-prod (targeted).
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook snippet: to rollback feature flag run: 
```
redwoodctl flags set structured_output_toolcall.enabled=false --env=hosted-prod --id=rollout-2026-03-15-phi
```
ops-runbook-bot: Confirm when flag is toggled so we can observe metrics.
maya: flag is off on all canaries. I see traffic routing away from the new path. still seeing high KV counts.
liu: batching hotfix: reducing max_batch_tokens and disabling continuous-batching heuristics that rely on tool-call framing. applying now.

liu: applying patch to configmap redwood-batcher-config in prod: 
```
kubectl -n redwood patch configmap redwood-batcher-config --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/max_batch_tokens","value":"1024"}, {"op":"replace","path":"/data/continuous_batching_enabled","value":"false"}]'
```

sam: rolling restart batcher pods to pick up config. command: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/redwood-batcher -n redwood`
ev an: restarting two batches in us-west-2 now (pods: batcher-3, batcher-4).

maya: after restart, p99 dropped from 4.1s to 1.2s in 2m. error rate still elevated though (~6%).

jess: next: aggressive trimming of KV namespace 'kv:kcache:user:structured' — trimming keys older than 2m and capping prefix to 100k keys. Use internal kvctl.

liu: running evict command (dry-run first): 
```
/opt/redwood/bin/kvctl list --prefix kv:kcache:user:structured --older-than 120 --limit 100000
/opt/redwood/bin/kvctl evict --prefix kv:kcache:user:structured --older-than 120
```

liu: evict started, approx 1.2M keys queued; throughput 20k/s. Expect 60s for initial sweep.
maya: after eviction throughput of batcher normalized and latency p99 down to 380ms, error rate ~1.2%.

customer-success-bot: Notifying affected customers: sending banner to tenants with error spikes > 5% and high latency > 1s. Draft message queued.
jess: placing a temporary rule: route traffic to warm standby model variant for tenants with heavy tool-call patterns. Adds extra cost but reduces failure rate.
ev an: implemented routing override for tenant segments A,B (heavy toolcall). verifying.

sam: quick note — root cause preliminary: structured output changes caused more unique tool identifiers and embeddings in responses, which changed how prefix hashing for KV cache keys was computed; continuous-batching relied on stable key shapes and now many requests bypass prefix match, creating many tiny cache entries -> memory blowup + increased cache eviction churn -> batcher failing to form steady batches -> dispatch errors for tool_call frames.

jess: mitigation summary (completed): turned off structured-output rollout, patched batcher config (max_batch_tokens=1024, continuous_batching=false), evicted affected KV prefix, added routing override for heavy toolcall tenants, restarted batcher pods.

maya: monitoring for 30m. initial customer reports show improvements.

incident_commander: Impact assessment: ~45k requests affected over 15m window, ~8 tenants reported degraded UX (chat truncation, tool-call failures). No data exfiltration. No customer data loss. Security signoff not required.

customer-success-bot: Sent targeted messages to 8 tenants. CS will follow up with post-incident notes.

jess: tagging oncall handoff. @evan will take post-incident monitoring for next 2 hours, then hand over to night oncall @sam.
ev an: taking monitoring. will escalate back into channel if regressions.

sam: acknowledged, will be on-call from 21:00 PT.

jess: Postmortem owners: assign to @maya and @liu for technical write-up (root cause + long-term fix), assign @jess for customer communication & RCA timeline. Targeting write-up draft in 48h.
maya: immediate action items I'll own: 1) add unit/integration tests for structured-output->kv-key hashing 2) add limits for prefix cardinality detection + circuit-breaker to prevent cache blowups.

liu: infra followups: 1) safer default batcher config for rollouts 2) telemetry alert on kv prefix growth (keys/min) 3) automatic rollback trigger if continuous batching fails to form batches for > 3m.

jess: any remaining visible customer issues?

customer-success-bot: two tenants reported transient issues are resolved; one tenant still seeing delayed tool invocations, CS engaged.

maya: investigating the one tenant — may be a client-side expectation on structured output parsing. will coordinate with CS.

jess: thanks everyone. I'll keep thread updated. tagging SRE for a follow-up blameless postmortem. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Incident auto-update will post summary in 1h. If no further activity, incident will be marked resolved after 2h of stable metrics.

jess: closing active mitigation — monitoring window in progress. change log: rollout aborted, batcher config hotfix, kv eviction sweep, routing overrides.

evan: noted. I'll hand off after 2h stable.

maya: adding final note: avoid making hashing/serialization changes that alter cache key shape during rollouts without a compatibility toggle.

jess: end of thread updates will be added to incidents tracker and the postmortem doc link will be posted here when ready.
